visualCharacteristics.purpose: one display-size serif statement on an immersive ground, with an optional attribution
visualCharacteristics.typography: heading font at the display size (60px desktop / 40px mobile), weight 400, 790px measure, centred

contentPattern.structure: row 1: the statement (a heading or plain text); row 2 (optional): attribution text

usage: One per page at most, in a section styled black: founder quotations and short programme statements.
reuseGuidance: Only verbatim, attributed quotations or programme statements; never partner facts or claims. Style the section black (the block adds the black ground when the section has none).
